description: Landlord and property manager tool — tenants, leases, maintenance requests, rent collection, and financial reporting. Real Estate industry only.

three_js.description: Isometric grid lines suggesting a floor plan or architectural blueprint. Clean, precise, structured. Lines animate in from edges on load.
three_js.avoid: no status pills, no hero-stat-line, no ticker strips

relationships: Lease belongs to a Tenant and a Unit
RentPayment belongs to Lease and Tenant
MaintenanceRequest belongs to Unit, filed by Tenant or Landlord
Expense belongs to Property — repairs, fees, insurance
Document belongs to Property, Unit, or Lease — agreements, certificates
Inspection belongs to Unit with a date and report
Notification belongs to Landlord — rent due, maintenance updates, lease renewals

primary_flows: Add property → add units → add tenant → create lease → track rent payments
Tenant submits maintenance request → landlord views → assigns → marks resolved

layout.notes: Rent status colour coding must be consistent across all form factors — green paid, amber due, red overdue. This is the single most important data signal in the product.

avoid: Never show financial data without specifying currency
Never mix income and expense in the same row without clear visual separation
Never send automated communications to tenants without landlord preview and confirmation
Never delete a record permanently — always archive with full history preserved
Never auto-apply late fees without explicit rule configuration and landlord confirmation
Never show occupancy rate as a percentage without the underlying unit count
Never use a modal for maintenance request details — full screen navigation
Never collapse property financial history — always show full audit trail
enforce: Rent status always colour-coded: paid green, due amber, overdue red — across every screen
Maintenance priority always shown: urgent red, normal amber, low grey
Lease expiry always shown with days remaining — red under 30 days, amber under 90
All financial figures right-aligned in lists and tables
Tenant communication history always preserved and viewable
Late fee calculations always shown with breakdown — never just a total
Inspection reports always include date, inspector, and photo evidence count
All bulk actions require confirmation showing exactly how many records are affected

empty_states.ui: Building illustration. Message: 'Add your first property to get started'. CTA: 'Add property'. Step-by-step onboarding checklist: add property, add units, add tenants.
Wrench illustration. Message: 'No maintenance requests'. Sub: 'Requests submitted by tenants will appear here'. Not 'nothing to do' — this is expected positive state.
Chart illustration. Message: 'Financial data will appear here'. Sub: 'Record your first rent payment or expense to see reports'.

loading_states.ui: KPI cards skeleton — 4 cards in row shimmer. Property list skeleton below — 3 property rows with status badge placeholder.
Tenant rows skeleton — name left, due date centre, amount right, status badge far right. All shimmer. Month selector visible and interactive.
Request cards skeleton — title, property badge, status badge, date. 4 skeleton cards shimmer.

error_flows.ui: Form stays open. Red inline error at top. Specific reason shown. Payment NOT recorded. Retry with same details — no re-entry needed.
Message draft preserved. Red error: 'Message not sent'. Retry option. Option to copy and send manually. Never silently drop the message.
Error shown with reason. Draft data preserved. Option to try again or download editable template instead.
Toast: 'Could not notify contractor'. Request still saved. Option to notify manually — phone or email shown. Status not automatically updated to assigned.

edge_cases.ui: Vacancy alert shown prominently on property card. Red occupancy badge. 'List vacant unit' CTA shown directly on dashboard card.

edge_cases.case: Lease ending in the past (overdue renewal)
edge_cases.ui: Lease shown as 'Expired' in red. Urgent banner on tenant detail: 'Lease expired [X days] ago. Renew or begin eviction process.' Legal resources linked.

edge_cases.case: Multiple tenants on same unit (joint tenancy)
edge_cases.ui: All tenant names shown on unit. Rent split configuration shown. Communications sent to all tenants by default. One tenant paying full rent is a separate config.
Request flagged as 'Unknown submitter'. Landlord notified. Option to link to existing tenant, add new tenant, or reject request.
